content_blocks.label: clause_1._Definition_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party which is marked as confidential or which should reasonably be considered confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Duration_of_Obligation
content_blocks.text: The obligations of confidentiality set forth herein shall remain in effect for a period of five (5) years from the effective date of this Agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Exceptions
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information if required by law, provided that it gives prompt notice to the Disclosing Party and seeks its assistance in obtaining a protective order.
